facts.fact: Statistics Sierra Leone states the 2021 Mid-Term Population and Housing Census, its first digital census, was enumerated in December 2021 with census night on 9 December 2021, counting 7,548,702 people across 23,736 enumeration areas.

Statistics Sierra Leone published the final results of the 2021 Mid-Term Population and Housing Census in a report dated September 2022 (total population 7,548,702), after provisional results announced on 31 May 2022 changed by only 7,061 persons.
